verses.text: Ha tikne'ik, hex wuktak hex wanab', tzin nib'ej swal t'ayex tas ix aj scheklajel swach'k'olal Dios t'a heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia t'a yol yik Macedonia tik.
Wach'chom ix ak'ji prowal heb' yuj juntzanh yahelal ix ja t'a yib'anh heb', palta ix te tzalaj heb'. Wach'chom te meb'a' heb', palta haxo swilani, niwan slaj yak' heb', icha yak'an heb' b'eyum.
Swak' testigo'al hin b'a yuj heb', yujto yelk'olal ix yak' jantak ix techaj yuj heb'. Te ek'alto wal ix yak' heb'.
Ix tewi heb' t'ayonh yik sko cha yak' skolwal heb', yujto snib'ej pax heb' skolwaj t'a heb' yikxo Dios.

Ix ko na'ani to kennhej jab'ok ol yak' heb', palta yelxo wal más niwan ix yak' heb'. B'ab'el ix yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Kajal Jesús. Hanhejtona' ichato ix yak'pax sb'a heb' t'ayonh icha snib'ej Dios.
Yuj chi' sko k'anxi pawor t'a winhaj Tito tik yik sb'atxi winh hex yila'. Ha winh ol b'at cha'an heyofrenda ol heyak' yuj swach'il he k'o'ol. Yujto ha t'a winh ix he cha'el yich heyak'ani.

Manh jantakok swach'il tzeyutej he b'a. Tzeyak'an wal och t'a he k'o'ol. Jelan tzeyutej he b'a he k'ayb'ani. Yelk'olal te wach' tzeyutej he b'a he k'ulan junok tasi. Tzonh he xajanan paxi. Yuj chi' tze ch'ox pax he wach'il heyak'an heyofrenda chi'.
Ha jun swalb'at tik t'ayex, manh cheknab'ilok yaji. Tonhej hin gana tzeyab'i chajtil syutej juntzanhxo heb' yak'an skolwal, yik scheklajeli to t'a wal yel tze xajanej heb' ketcreyente'al.

Kojtak to ha Kajal Jesucristo, te niwan swach'k'olal. Wach'chom manh jantakok sb'eyumal t'a satcha'anh, palta ix ul yak'och sb'a meb'a'il ku'uj. Icha chi' ix yutej sb'a, yik wach' yuj smeb'a'il chi' tzonh och b'eyumal.
Yuj he wach'ilok swalb'at t'ayex tas tzin na yuj heyofrenda chi'. Ix el yab'ilal he cha'anel yich he yak'ani, yujto ix el wal t'a he k'o'ol heyak'ani.
Ha tikne'ik, hin gana to tzeyak' heyip he wach' ak'ankani. Icha ix heyutej he cha'anel yich heyak'an t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, icha chi' tzeyutej he lajankan tikne'ik, hato syala' tastak ay t'ayex.
Chab'il kofrenda chi' yuj Dios hato syala' tastak ay t'ayonh, tato manhok yet' chab'k'olal skak'a'. Max sk'anlaj tato malaj tas t'ayonh.
Mantok hin gana tzex ochkan meb'a'il, yuj slajwi'el tastak ay t'ayex, yik tzex kolwaj t'a juntzanhxo heb'.

Palta hin gana lajan tzonh aj ko masanil. Ha tikne'ik, ha tas syak' sobre t'ayex, syal heyak'an t'a heb' max tzak'wan yiko'. Haxo t'a jun'elxo, haxo heb' ol ak'anxok pax t'ayex ayik manh ol hex tzak'wan t'a he yiko'. Tato icha chi', lajan ol honh aj ko masanil.
Yujto icha tik syalkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Ha heb' niwan tas smolkani, max yak'laj sobre yik heb', haxo heb' jab'nhej tas smolkani, max yak'laj palta t'a heb', xchi.
Swak' yuj diosal t'a Dios, yujto ha tz'ak'an sna'a winhaj Tito yik tzex sya'ilej winh, icha ix wutej hex wilan ha hin tik.
Ayik ix ko k'anan pawor t'a winh yik sb'at winh hex yila', elanhchamel ix tak'wi winh. Toxon snib'ej pax winh sb'at hex yila', yuj chi' ol b'at winh.
Ay junxo winh kuktak ol ko chekb'at yet' winh. Ha jun winh kuktak tik, tz'alji winh wach'il yuj heb' creyente ay t'a junjun iglesia, yujto smunlaj wal winh yalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.

Hanhejtona', haton jun winh kuktak tik sik'nakelta heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia, yik tz'ek' scha'an jun ofrenda chi' winh ket'ok. Wan ko molan jun ofrenda tik, yik ol cheklaj swach'il Kajal Jesús yet' swach'il he k'o'ol ha hex tik.
Ko gana ha honh tik to malaj mach tzonh alub'tanhan yuj chajtil tz'aj ek' kik'ancha'anh juntzanh ofrenda tik.
Yuj chi' te tojol skutej juntzanh tik. Manhoknhej t'a yichanh Kajal Jesús tojol skutej ko b'a, hanhejtona' tojol skutej ko b'a t'a yichanh heb' ketanima'il.

Ay junxo winh kuktak ol ko chekb'at yet' heb' winh tik. Ha jun winh tik, tzijtum elxo skila' to wach' smunlaj winh t'a yik Kajal Jesús. Ha tikne'ik, yel ay snib'ej winh smunlaji, yujto tzex yak' wal och winh yipok sk'o'ol.

Tato ay heb' sk'anb'an winhaj Tito chi' t'ayex, tzeyal t'a heb': Yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' winhaj Pablo, ayul winh munlajel t'a ko kal tik, xe chi. Tato ay pax mach sk'anb'an yuj chawanh heb' winh kuktak yetb'eyum sb'a yet' winhaj Tito tik, tzeyal t'a heb': Ha heb' winh tik, chekb'ilkot heb' winh yuj juntzanhxo iglesia, scheklaj wal el swach'il Cristo yuj heb' winh, xe chi.
Ayik ol k'och heb' winh ta', tze xajanej heb' winh. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' winh, ol he ch'ox t'a heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia to yel skala' ayik ix hex kalan wach'il.
